name: Rollganic Live Resin | The Whip
description:
This premium concentrate is crafted from the highly regarded The Whip strain, which is known for its uplifting effects and tantalizing flavor profile.

The Whip strain offers a balanced flavor profile with sweet citrus, tropical fruit, and a touch of earthy spice.

These complex and refreshing notes are accompanied by subtle hints of pine, making for a vibrant and enticing aromatic experience that will captivate your senses.
